```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  # 1. CI Matrix: Verify build, tests, and Rust scaffold before release
  ci:
    name: CI (${{ matrix.os }}, Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}, Backend: ${{ matrix.backend }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: ['3.2', '3.3']
        backend: ['native', 'pure']
        include:
          # Rust scaffold check on Ubuntu only (bindgen dependencies easier to manage)
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ruby-version: '3.2'
            backend: 'rust'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Rust (for Rust backend/scaffold)
        if: matrix.backend == 'rust'
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install system dependencies (for Rust bindgen)
        if: matrix.backend == 'rust' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libclang-dev pkg-config

      - name: Install system dependencies (for Rust bindgen on macOS)
        if: matrix.backend == 'rust' && runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install llvm pkg-config

      - name: Run Tests
        env:
          LDA_RUBY_BACKEND: ${{ matrix.backend }}
        run: |
          bundle exec rake test

      - name: Check Rust Scaffold (cargo check)
        if: matrix.backend == 'rust'
        run: |
          cd ext/lda-ruby-rust
          cargo check

  # 2. Release Process using release-plz
  release:
    name: Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [ci]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Run release-plz
        uses: release-plz/action@v0.5
        with:
          command: release
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
